annotations.title: Detect anomalies in a time series

description: Anomaly detection on a time series: score recent periods against history with BigQuery AI.DETECT_ANOMALIES (TimesFM). Give one table and its latest periods are scored against its own history, or a history and a target table. Returns every checked row with bounds, anomaly flag and probability, plus the anomaly count. Input: history_table, target_table, timestamp_col, data_col; optional target_last, threshold, id_cols. $10.00 per call. Returns: history_table, target_table, timestamp_col, data_col, anomaly_prob_threshold, mode, target_periods, columns[], rows[], row_count, anomaly_count, gib_processed.

id_cols.description: Optional: one series per value of these columns.

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language tag (en, ja, ko, pt-BR): the human-readable strings of the result (notes, details, reasons) are translated into this language; data, codes, numbers and URLs are untouched. Default: as produced.

target_last.description: Same table as history and target: score its latest N timestamps. Default 30.

name: hubvibe_data_anomalies
